integrity: The primary source was inspected at Theorem 4.1 and its proof, including the exact use of the zero-measure hypothesis. The proposed family was independently checked for boundedness, continuity, finiteness, plurisubharmonicity, failure of pluriharmonicity, and the exact harmonic-slice set. The exceptional-direction measure follows from the exact Beta(1,n-1) law for one squared coordinate on the complex unit sphere. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result establishes sharpness only for the surface-measure size of the exceptional direction set. It does not classify exceptional sets by capacity, category, Hausdorff dimension, or projective geometry. The explicit counterexample is continuous but nonsmooth across a real hypersurface.
title: Measure-theoretic sharpness of almost-everywhere harmonic-slice rigidity
